text_en: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered:
text_cn: 特曼人厄里法次接着说：

text_en: “Can a mortal be of use to God? Can even the wisest be of service to him?
text_cn: 人为天主能有什么益处？明智人只能于一己有益。

text_en: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty if you are righteous, or is it gain to him if you make your ways blameless?
text_cn: 纵然你公正，对全能者能有什么好处？纵然你品行齐全，对天主有什么利益？

text_en: Is it for your piety that he reproves you, and enters into judgment with you?
text_cn: 他岂能因你敬畏之心而责斥你，拉你来听审？

text_en: Is not your wickedness great? There is no end to your iniquities.
text_cn: 岂不是因为你罪恶多端，罪过无穷？

text_en: For you have exacted pledges from your family for no reason, and stripped the naked of their clothing.
text_cn: 因为你无理地强取了你兄弟的抵押，剥去了人的衣服，使之赤裸；

text_en: You have given no water to the weary to drink, and you have withheld bread from the hungry.
text_cn: 口渴的人，你没有给他水喝；饥饿的人，你没有给他饭吃；

text_en: The powerful possess the land, and the favored live in it.
text_cn: 让强有力的人占有土地，让尊贵体面的人住在其中；

text_en: You have sent widows away empty-handed, and the arms of the orphans you have crushed.
text_cn: 却使寡妇空手而归，折断孤儿的手臂；

text_en: Therefore snares are around you, and sudden terror overwhelms you,
text_cn: 因此罗网要四面围困你，恐吓突降，使你惊惶。

text_en: or darkness so that you cannot see; a flood of water covers you.
text_cn: 光明变成黑暗，使你毫无所见；洪水漫漫，将你淹没。

text_en: “Is not God high in the heavens? See the highest stars, how lofty they are!
text_cn: 天主岂不是居于高天？看，最高的星辰何其高远？

text_en: Therefore you say, ‘What does God know? Can he judge through the deep darkness?
text_cn: 你曾说过：“天主知道什么？他岂能透过黑云施行审判？

text_en: Thick clouds enwrap him, so that he does not see, and he walks on the dome of heaven. ’
text_cn: 云彩遮蔽着他，使他看不到什么，而他只在天边周围游行。”

text_en: Will you keep to the old way that the wicked have trod?
text_cn: 你岂要固守恶人所蹈的故辙？

text_en: They were snatched away before their time; their foundation was washed away by a flood.
text_cn: 尚未到时，他们已被攫（jué）去，大水冲去了他们的基础。

text_en: They said to God, ‘Leave us alone, ’ and ‘What can the Almighty do to us? ’
text_cn: 他们曾向天主说：“离开我们！全能者能为我们作什么？”

text_en: Yet he filled their houses with good things— but the plans of the wicked are repugnant to me.
text_cn: 他原来是以福利充满了他们的家，可是恶人的思想离他很远。

text_en: The righteous see it and are glad; the innocent laugh them to scorn,
text_cn: 义人见了就欢乐，无罪者也讥笑他们说：

text_en: saying, ‘Surely our adversaries are cut off, and what they left, the fire has consumed. ’
text_cn: “的确，他们的财富已被消灭，他们所剩余的皆被火焚毁。”

text_en: “Agree with God, and be at peace; in this way good will come to you.
text_cn: 请你与他亲善和好， 借此你的幸福必得恢复。

text_en: Receive instruction from his mouth, and lay up his words in your heart.
text_cn: 请你领受他口中的教训，将他的话存在心中。

text_en: If you return to the Almighty, you will be restored, if you remove unrighteousness from your tents,
text_cn: 如果你归向全能者，你必兴起；你若使邪恶离开你的帐幕，

text_en: if you treat gold like dust, and gold of Ophir like the stones of the torrent-bed,
text_cn: 视金子如尘埃，视敖非尔金如溪石，

text_en: and if the Almighty is your gold and your precious silver,
text_cn: 全能者必作为你的精金，作为你的银堆。

text_en: then you will delight yourself in the Almighty, and lift up your face to God.
text_cn: 那时你必以全能者为喜乐，向天主仰起你的头来。

text_en: You will pray to him, and he will hear you, and you will pay your vows.
text_cn: 那时你祈求他，他必应允你；你可向他还你的誓愿。

text_en: You will decide on a matter, and it will be established for you, and light will shine on your ways.
text_cn: 你决定的事，事必成就；光明要照耀你的道路，

text_en: When others are humiliated, you say it is pride; for he saves the humble.
text_cn: 因为他压伏骄傲的人，拯救低首下心的人。

text_en: He will deliver even those who are guilty; they will escape because of the cleanness of your hands. ”
text_cn: 他必解救无罪的人；你若手中清廉，你必获救。
